summary: Completed the six-part IPC migration: multimodal inputs and opaque registry migrations already present on main were verified; all request time-stat classes now use msgspec structs with trace snapshots, metric exclusion, enum preservation, and cross-process clock calibration; msgpack is the default; customized_info and Mooncake multimodal metadata use native typed payloads without field-level PickleWrapper wrappers.

tests.what_was_measured: 176 tests plus 35 subtests: typed producer-consumer MessagePack round trips, legacy pickle round trips, multimodal tensors/arrays/proxy state, Mooncake metadata, customized_info, time calibration, trace serialization, and metrics exclusion.

tests.command: SGLANG_USE_PICKLE_IPC={0,1} loopback sock_send/sock_recv TokenizedGenerateReqInput with APIServerReqTimeStats
tests.what_was_measured: Actual transport selection in separate interpreter processes: msgpack mode produced a 265-byte frame and legacy pickle mode produced a 1866-byte frame; both reconstructed APIServerReqTimeStats. The unset environment reported default False.

tests.command: PYTHONPATH=python /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-b471854f11d2/venv/bin/python -m compileall -q python/sglang/srt/managers python/sglang/srt/observability python/sglang/srt/disaggregation/encoder/receiver.py && git diff --check
tests.what_was_measured: Python syntax/import compilation and whitespace validity.

gpu_evidence: On the assigned AMD Instinct MI350X (gfx950), test_generate_mm_inputs_round_trip_preserves_cuda_tensor_device passed and verified decoded torch tensors remained on cuda:0. CUDA IPC proxy wire-state and fallback tensor tests also passed.
remaining_limitations: A real NVIDIA CUDA inter-process handle lifetime test could not run on the assigned AMD ROCm GPU; SGLang intentionally rejects the cuda_ipc transport on non-NVIDIA platforms. Opaque CUDA IPC proxy state and GPU tensor device preservation were exercised, but a live cross-process CUDA handle remains platform-blocked.
The full upstream CI matrix was not available locally; focused IPC, tracing, disaggregation, and producer-consumer tests passed.
